lead: An `examples/` fixture's source is frozen by nothing, so it can name members that never existed and blame your class.
body: `examples/reflect.nvs`, `crypto.nvs` and `cli.nvs` were written ahead of their members and asked for a property, an unregistered member (`Core\Arr::length`) and a top-level `function`, surfacing as `E0405`/`E0401`. Only its `[[check]]` `want` lines are frozen: `nvs run` it and `grep -n 'name: "..."'` in the owning module before reading the failure as a gap.
